_comment: Extensible config for AI SQL agent. Add tables/columns here when schema changes. Run scripts/refresh_schema_for_ai.py after adding DB tables.

column_semantic_hints.NETWR: Net value / amount – use for sales, costs, revenue aggregation (SUM)
column_semantic_hints.MATNR: Material number – join to MAKT for product names
column_semantic_hints.KUNNR: Customer number – join to KNA1 for customer details
column_semantic_hints.KUNAG: Sold-to customer on VBRK – use VBRK.KUNAG directly for 'by customer' grouping (avoids empty results from incomplete KNA1 data). Join to KNA1.KUNNR only when customer NAME is needed.
column_semantic_hints.LIFNR: Vendor number – join to LFA1 for vendor names
column_semantic_hints.VBELN: Document number – common join key (billing, delivery, sales)
column_semantic_hints.EBELN: Purchase order number – join key for EKKO/EKPO
column_semantic_hints.GJAHR: Fiscal year – use for year filter in FAGLFLEXA, RBKP, BSEG etc.
column_semantic_hints.FKDAT: Billing date (YYYYMMDD) – for sales date filters
column_semantic_hints.BUDAT: Posting date (YYYYMMDD) – for vendor invoice date filters
column_semantic_hints.BEDAT: Purchasing document date (YYYYMMDD) – for PO date filters
column_semantic_hints.LAND1: Country code – VBRK.LAND1 is PREFERRED for country on billing queries (no extra join needed); KNA1.LAND1 is the alternative via join
column_semantic_hints.MAKTX: Material description – use for product labels
column_semantic_hints.BRSCH: Industry code – join T016T for industry name
column_semantic_hints.BRTXT: Industry description – use for industry labels
column_semantic_hints.WAERS: Currency code – used in EKKO, RBKP, EKPO, RSEG, KONV, CKMLCR
column_semantic_hints.WAERK: Currency code for VBRK (billing header) – NOT WAERS. Always use WAERK for billing currency.
column_semantic_hints.RTCUR: Transaction currency in FAGLFLEXA – NOT WAERS. Use RTCUR for FAGLFLEXA currency.
column_semantic_hints.RWCUR: Second local currency in FAGLFLEXA – alternative to RTCUR.
column_semantic_hints.HWAER: Company code currency in KEKO (costing) – NOT WAERS. Use HWAER for KEKO currency.
column_semantic_hints.PRCTR: Profit center – use for GROUP BY profit center analysis (FAGLFLEXA.prctr or COEP.PRCTR)
column_semantic_hints.HSL: Amount in local (company code) currency – primary aggregation column for FAGLFLEXA cost/revenue
column_semantic_hints.RACCT: G/L account number (FAGLFLEXA) – use for account-level analysis
column_semantic_hints.RBUKRS: Company code (FAGLFLEXA) – use for company code filter or grouping
column_semantic_hints.RYEAR: Fiscal year (FAGLFLEXA) – use for year filter: FAGLFLEXA.ryear = '2023'
column_semantic_hints.POPER: Posting period 01-12 (FAGLFLEXA) – use for monthly/period filter
column_semantic_hints.DRCRK: Debit/credit indicator in FAGLFLEXA: S=debit (cost), H=credit
column_semantic_hints.KNUMV: Pricing document number – join key: VBRK.KNUMV = KONV.KNUMV or VBAK.KNUMV = KONV.KNUMV
column_semantic_hints.KSCHL: Condition type in KONV (e.g. PR00=base price, K007=customer discount, RA01=rebate)
column_semantic_hints.KBETR: Condition rate/amount in KONV – the actual price or discount value
column_semantic_hints.KOSTL: Cost center – join to CSKS for description (COEP.KOSTL = CSKS.KOSTL)
column_semantic_hints.KSTAR: Cost element – used in COEP and FAGLFLEXA for cost breakdown
column_semantic_hints.WERTN: Total cost value in CKIS (costing items) – use SUM(wertn) for total standard cost
column_semantic_hints.STPRS: Standard price in KEKO (cost estimate header) – unit standard cost
column_semantic_hints.KALNR: Costing number – join key: KEKO.KALNR = CKIS.KALNR = CKMLCR.KALNR = CKMLHD.KALNR
column_semantic_hints.IDNRK: Component material number in STPO (BOM items) – join to MAKT.MATNR for description
column_semantic_hints.STLNR: BOM number – join key: STKO.STLNR = STPO.STLNR
column_semantic_hints.STLTY: BOM type (M=material, E=equipment, etc.) – used with STLNR as composite key
column_semantic_hints.BDATJ: Fiscal year in CKMLCR/CKMLPP – use for year filter on actual costing
column_semantic_hints.KSCHL: Condition type in KONV: PR00=base price, K007=customer disc, RA01=rebate, VPRS=COGS cost, MWST=tax
column_semantic_hints.KAPPL: Condition application in KONV: V=sales pricing, M=purchasing
column_semantic_hints.KDATU: Condition validity date in KONV (YYYYMMDD) – use for active condition filters
column_semantic_hints.KAWRT: Condition base value in KONV – the base amount the condition applies to
column_semantic_hints.COMPREAS: Complaint reason code in VBRP – abbreviation for complaints reason. Filter WHERE TRIM(compreas) != '' for complaint/claim items. Use for: complaints by customer, complaint count.
column_semantic_hints.AUGDT: Clearing date in BSAD (AR cleared items) – when the invoice was cleared/paid
column_semantic_hints.DMBTR: Amount in local currency (BSAD, BSEG) – use for AR analysis
column_semantic_hints.RMWWR: Gross invoice amount in RBKP (vendor invoice header) – total invoice value
column_semantic_hints.SALK3: Stock value in CKMLCR – total inventory value for the period
column_semantic_hints.PVPRS: Moving average price in CKMLCR – actual periodic price
column_semantic_hints.BDMNG: Reserved quantity in RESB – use SUM(bdmng) for total reserved quantity by material. Join RESB to MAKT on matnr for material names.
column_semantic_hints.ENMNG: Issued/withdrawn quantity in RESB – quantity already withdrawn from reservation. Open qty = bdmng - enmng.

table_semantic_hints.VBRP: Billing document item – sales by product, amounts, quantities, compreas (complaint reason). Join VBRK for header, KNA1 for customer. Use compreas for complaint/claim analysis.
table_semantic_hints.vbrp: Same as VBRP – billing item for sales analysis.
table_semantic_hints.VBRK: Billing document header – invoice dates, customer (KUNAG=sold-to), currency (WAERK), country (LAND1 – use this directly for country grouping), kdgrp (customer group), vkorg (sales org), vtweg (distribution channel). PREFERRED for 'by country' queries: use VBRK.LAND1 directly. PREFERRED for 'by customer' queries: group by VBRK.KUNAG.
table_semantic_hints.KNA1: Customer master – names, country (LAND1), industry (brsch). Use T016T for industry text.
table_semantic_hints.MAKT: Material descriptions – MAKTX for product names. Join on MATNR.
table_semantic_hints.T016T: Industry descriptions – BRTXT for industry names. Join KNA1.brsch = T016T.brsch.
table_semantic_hints.EKKO: Purchase order header – vendor (LIFNR), dates (BEDAT), currency.
table_semantic_hints.EKPO: Purchase order item – amounts (NETWR), quantities, materials.
table_semantic_hints.RBKP: Vendor invoice header – vendor (LIFNR), amount (RMWWR), date (BUDAT).
table_semantic_hints.RSEG: Vendor invoice item – amounts (WRBTR, DMBTR), quantities.
table_semantic_hints.LFB1: Vendor company code – accounting and payment terms per vendor.
table_semantic_hints.LFM1: Vendor purchasing org – purchasing data per vendor.
table_semantic_hints.LIKP: Outbound delivery header – delivery documents, ship-to.
table_semantic_hints.VBAK: Sales order header – customer, order dates.
table_semantic_hints.VBAP: Sales order item – products, quantities, values.
table_semantic_hints.BSAD: Customer cleared items – AR line items, amounts (DMBTR, WRBTR).
table_semantic_hints.BSEG: Accounting document segment – amounts, customers, vendors.
table_semantic_hints.FAGLFLEXA: New G/L line items (FAGLFLEXA) – actual GL postings with profit center, account, cost center, amounts. Key columns: prctr (profit center), racct (GL account), rbukrs (company code), hsl (amount in local currency – USE THIS for cost/amount aggregation), wsl (transaction currency amount), ryear/gjahr (fiscal year), poper (posting period 01-12), drcrk (S=debit/H=credit), budat (posting date), cost_elem (cost element), rcntr (cost center), kokrs (controlling area). For 'total cost by profit center': SELECT prctr, SUM(hsl) FROM FAGLFLEXA GROUP BY prctr.
table_semantic_hints.KONV: Pricing conditions (KONV) – pricing, discounts, surcharges per sales document. Key columns: knumv (pricing doc number, join to VBRK.KNUMV or VBAK.KNUMV), kschl (condition type: PR00=price, K007=discount, RA01=rebate), kbetr (condition amount/rate), waers (currency), kappl (V=sales/M=purchasing). To get price conditions: JOIN VBRK on VBRK.KNUMV = KONV.KNUMV.
table_semantic_hints.VBFA: Sales document flow (VBFA) – predecessor/successor document links. Key: vbelv=predecessor doc, vbeln=successor doc, vbtyp_n=type (J=delivery, M=billing doc, C=order). Use to trace order→delivery→invoice chain.
table_semantic_hints.COEP: CO line items – actual cost postings by cost center, profit center and cost element.
table_semantic_hints.COSP: CO plan totals – planned costs by cost center, period and cost element.
table_semantic_hints.CEPC: Profit center master – profit centers and their attributes.
table_semantic_hints.CSKS: Cost center master – cost centers and their attributes.
table_semantic_hints.CRHD: Work centers – capacities and assignments by plant.
table_semantic_hints.AUFK: Order master – internal orders / production orders (by plant, type, status).
table_semantic_hints.CKHS: Costing header status – status of cost estimates per company code.
table_semantic_hints.CKIS: Costing items – detailed cost components for a cost estimate.
table_semantic_hints.CKMLCR: Material ledger: cumulative values – actual costing per material/plant.
table_semantic_hints.CKMLHD: Material ledger: header – identifies material ledger objects.
table_semantic_hints.CKMLPP: Material ledger: periodic values – period-based actual costs.
table_semantic_hints.KEKO: Cost estimate header – standard cost estimate per material/plant.
table_semantic_hints.KEPH: Cost estimate items – cost breakdown per cost estimate.
table_semantic_hints.STKO: BOM header – bill of material definitions.
table_semantic_hints.MARC: Material-plant data – MRP, stock, and logistics settings per plant.
table_semantic_hints.MARM: Material units of measure – conversion factors and GTINs.
table_semantic_hints.MEAN: Material EAN/UPC codes – barcode mapping for materials.
table_semantic_hints.MKPF: Material document header – goods movement header (posting date).
table_semantic_hints.RESB: Reservations – reserved quantities by material, plant, and order. Key columns: bdmng (reserved qty), enmng (issued qty), matnr, werks. Use SUM(bdmng) for total reserved; join MAKT on matnr for material names. For 'highest reserved by material': GROUP BY matnr, HAVING SUM(bdmng) > 0 ORDER BY reserved DESC.
table_semantic_hints.LSEG: Warehouse document segment – WM quantities and locations.
table_semantic_hints.CKMLCR: Material ledger cumulative values – periodic actual costs. Key columns: kalnr (join to CKMLHD for matnr), stprs (standard/periodic price), salk3 (stock value), waers, poper (period), bdatj (year). CRITICAL: no matnr column – must join CKMLHD on kalnr to get matnr.
table_semantic_hints.CKMLHD: Material ledger header – bridge table linking kalnr (costing number) to matnr (material) and bwkey (plant). Essential for joining CKMLCR to material descriptions.
table_semantic_hints.STKO: BOM header – stlnr (BOM number), stlty (type: M=material), datuv (valid-from). NOTE: no matnr on STKO itself; use STPO.idnrk for component materials.
table_semantic_hints.STPO: BOM component items – idnrk (component material = join to MAKT.matnr for name), stlnr (BOM number), menge (quantity), meins (UoM). Use idnrk to find component descriptions.
table_semantic_hints.BSAD: Customer cleared AR items – kunnr (customer), dmbtr (local currency amount), wrbtr (transaction currency amount), waers, budat (posting date), shkzg (S=debit/H=credit). Use for: AR aging, payment analysis.
table_semantic_hints.EBAN: Purchase requisitions – banfn (req number), matnr (material), menge (quantity), preis (price), waers, lifnr (vendor), lfdat (required delivery date), erdat (creation date), ebeln (assigned PO if converted). Use for: open PR analysis, procurement pipeline.
table_semantic_hints.KONV: Pricing conditions – knumv (join to VBRK.knumv), kschl (condition type: PR00=price, K007=discount, VPRS=COGS, RA01=rebate), kbetr (amount/rate), waers, kawrt (base value), kappl (V=sales/M=purchasing). IMPORTANT: VPRS = cost-of-goods condition for margin calculations. Join via VBRK.knumv = KONV.knumv.
table_semantic_hints.VBFA: Sales document flow – vbelv (predecessor), vbeln (successor), vbtyp_n (type: J=delivery, M=billing, C=order). Use to trace order → delivery → invoice chain.
table_semantic_hints.VBAK: Sales order header – vbeln (order number), kunnr (customer), audat (order date), knumv (pricing doc, join to KONV), vkorg (sales org), netwr (net order value). Use for: order analysis.
table_semantic_hints.VBAP: Sales order items – vbeln (order), posnr (item), matnr (material), kwmeng (order quantity), netwr (item net value), werks (plant). Use for: order line details.
table_semantic_hints.AUFK: Order master (internal/production orders) – aufnr, auart (type), ktext (description), kostl (cost center), prctr (profit center), werks (plant). Use for: production order analysis.
table_semantic_hints.CEPC: Profit center master – prctr, kokrs (controlling area), ktext (short text). Use for: profit center labels.
table_semantic_hints.CSKS: Cost center master – kostl, kokrs, ktext (short text). Use for: cost center labels.
table_semantic_hints.COEP: CO actual line items – kostl (cost center), prctr (profit center), kstar (cost element), wkgbtr (actual amount in CO currency), wtgbtr (transaction currency), gjahr, poper. Use for: actual cost breakdown.
table_semantic_hints.COSP: CO planned totals – kostl, kstar, gjahr, versn (version). Use for: budget vs actuals.
table_semantic_hints.KEKO: Cost estimate header – matnr, werks, kalnr (join to CKIS), kalka (costing type), hwaer (currency – NOT waers). NOTE: KEKO has NO stprs column. Standard cost = SUM(CKIS.wertn). Use CKMLCR.stprs for periodic price.
table_semantic_hints.CKIS: Costing items – kalnr (join to KEKO), wertn (cost value – SUM for total cost), kstar (cost element), matnr. Use for: cost breakdown by component/element, costs of manufacturing, manufacturing cost, production cost.
